ai.seo_question: Who is the narrator chain for the hadith on the dislike of night hunting in al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This concise narration in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *al-Istibsar* confirms the dislike (karāhah) of night hunting by transmitting the ruling directly from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) via Safwan al-Jawadi, a key figure in Shia hadith transmission. It highlights the continuity of the juristic principle that night hunting is less preferred, likely due to the difficulty in ensuring the animal is slaughtered in the name of Allah or the risk of wasting the meat. The chain underscores the reliability of the Kufan scholarly tradition in preserving these specific legal nuances.
